description: This file defines the ClaimRequestDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, which functions as a wrapper around ClaimRequest entities. It provides methods to manipulate and retrieve data related to claim requests, such as setting user and employee references, retrieving total expenses, and formatting submission dates. It also interacts with external services like PayGradeService and ClaimService to perform various operations.

classes.name: ClaimRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimRequest entities, providing methods to set associated entities, retrieve expenses, and format dates, facilitating interaction with claim request data in the system.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PayGradeService from the container.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Protected method to access the ClaimRequest instance stored in the decorator.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the claim request based on a provided user ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the currency type on the claim request using a currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Retrieves a CurrencyType entity based on a provided currency ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the claim request based on employee number.

methods.name: getTotalExpense
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total expense for the claim request by querying the claim service.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the submitted date of the claim request formatted as 'Y-m-d', or null if not set.
